changes: Hardened Windows 11 startup diagnostics & stability on PCs without a dedicated GPU (native SEH crash logging, automatic software RHI/OpenGL safe-boot fallback retry, 64-bit Win32 handle signatures, lazy DaVinci Resolve native library loading, and defensive QtMultimedia fallback).

Fixed Whisper model download failures (WinError 1314) on non-admin Windows 11 PCs by bypassing Hugging Face symlinks automatically, prevented incomplete snapshot folders from passing cache verification, and removed macOS-only firewall references from all 11 languages.

Added opt-in automatic crash reporting for unexpected technical errors during transcription and silence analysis, while keeping offline/firewall, missing-file, disk-full, and manual-cancel errors silent in telemetry.

Fixed Settings reopening cleanly maximized when previously closed maximized (eliminating right/bottom Windows 11 border and Linux Wayland/X11 spacing artifacts while keeping the exit-maximize icon accurate), and fixed Always-On-Top Z-order state sticking on Windows 11.
Eliminated Windows 11 white flash sheets on window open/reopen/close and the 1px white outline inside taskbar hover thumbnails via dark DWM border styling and paint-synchronized window cloaking.
Made installer upgrades and repairs transactional (downloading and extracting packages before cleaning old code) and explicitly ensured certifi is installed and verified.
